text:
dena: FYI spotted a tiny recurring billing blip after yesterday's router rollout. looks like resumed streams sometimes generate an extra ~4-8 tokens.
raj: can you drop a sample log?
dena: paste: 
```
2026-04-05T09:14:02Z INFO router: session=sess-77 route=us-west -> fallback region=eu-west
2026-04-05T09:14:03Z INFO stream: frag_start=0 frag_end=30 truncated=true toolcall=tc-11
2026-04-05T09:14:03Z INFO billing: provisional=30 ledger_key=sess-77#0
2026-04-05T09:14:03Z INFO stream: resume attempt=1 resume_id=r-9 suffix_seen=true
2026-04-05T09:14:03Z INFO billing: confirmed=35 ledger_key=sess-77#5
```
dena: provisional keyed to frag#0 but confirmed created frag#5, so +5 tokens.
lucas: sounds like resume landed on a backend that rewrote fragment indexing. we key by session+frag_start which breaks on route-change.
elainE: (typo) elaine: we currently do not propagate resume_id in router hop headers. that would let billing dedupe.
raj: short term: if resume_origin==fallback && suffix_seen then treat confirmed_token records as reconciles against nearest provisional within 10 tokens. ugly but less churn.
dena: agree on pragmatic fix. long term we should add resume_id and canonical_fragment_id to stream metadata and have ledger updates be idempotent by resume+frag_id.
lucas: i'll prototype a ledger key change: session_id + canonical_frag_id + resume_id optional. will keep backwards compat by storing old_key->new_key mappings for 7 days.
ops-bot: Deploy event: router/canary v1.5 deployed at 2026-04-05T08:58:00Z by elaine
billing-bot: Note: manual corrections available via /billing-correct; provide logs and session id.
elaine: dashboard idea: add a "provisional vs confirmed drift" small sparkline per-route + link to raw traces. that should cut down noisy pings.
raj: also need telemetry fields: resume_origin, resume_id, canonical_frag_id, route_before, route_after. add them to billing traces and trace sampling for 1% of resumes.
dena: ok folks, timeline? if lucas can prototype ledger lookup by EOD we can ship a conservative reconciliation rule tomorrow morning.
lucas: ack, i'll open PR for ledger shim with tests for idempotency.
raj: i'll queue console tile work low-risk.
elaine: and i'll add a debug-only alert for per-route drift > 0.1% in last 15m. no paging, just rollups.
dena: thanks team, throw any similar anomalies in this thread. :thumbsup
